summary.note: 100% of the 45,865 distinct BovineSNP50 positions in other_15 are present in other_1.1 (0.284% of sequence variants). While the higher-MAF loci Chr2:22 (-log10 P=7.64) and PLAG1 (-log10 P=17.33) retain genome-wide significance on the 50k chip, only DPF2/MUS81 (-log10 P=14.76) remains genome-wide significant among the major-effect recessive syndromes; PLCD4 (3.10), FGD4 (3.95), ARSI (2.91), MTRF1 (5.42), and GALNT2 (3.61) are all missed at 50k-chip resolution.
